title: LCGuard: Latent Communication Guard for Safe KV Sharing in Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Sadia Asif; Mohammad Mohammadi Amiri; Momin Abbas; Prasanna Sattigeri; Karthikeyan Natesan Ramamurthy

problem_statement.en: KV caches used for latent communication in multi-agent LLM systems can encode sensitive inputs and intermediate reasoning that remain recoverable even when agents never disclose them in text. Existing output-level safeguards and system-level cache isolation do not regulate the information content of intentionally shared KV representations.
problem_statement.zh: 多 agent LLM 系統以 KV cache 進行 latent communication 時，其中可能編碼敏感輸入與中間推理資訊；即使 agent 未透過 text 明確揭露，這些資訊仍可能遭重建。既有 output-level safeguard 與系統層級 cache isolation 無法管控刻意共享之 KV representation 的資訊內容。

key_innovation.en: LCGuard applies a lightweight residual bottleneck transformation to keys and values before cross-agent transmission and jointly trains these communication functions against adversarial reconstruction decoders. Its minimax objective preserves downstream utility while suppressing locally and compositionally reconstructable private information.
key_innovation.zh: LCGuard 在跨 agent 傳輸前，分別對 Key 與 Value 套用輕量 residual bottleneck transformation，並使 communication function 與 adversarial reconstruction decoder 進行聯合訓練。其 minimax objective 在維持下游效用的同時，抑制局部與跨 agent 組合後仍可重建的私密資訊。

baselines_compared: Vanilla KV Sharing, LatentMAS, KVComm, PrivAct, ADAPT, Per-Agent LCGuard

key_improvements.en: Full-System LCGuard reduces attack success rate by approximately 65–75% while preserving most task performance. In Qwen3-4B sequential PrivacyLens, ASR falls from 0.871 with Vanilla KV Sharing to 0.216 while helpfulness remains 0.710 versus 0.780.
key_improvements.zh: Full-System LCGuard 將 attack success rate 降低約 65–75%，同時保留大部分任務效能。在 Qwen3-4B sequential PrivacyLens 設定中，ASR 由 Vanilla KV Sharing 的 0.871 降至 0.216，而 helpfulness 仍達 0.710，相較基準為 0.780。

reuse_metric.en: Approximately 65–75% lower ASR while preserving most task performance; for Qwen3-4B sequential PrivacyLens, Full-System LCGuard retains 0.710 helpfulness versus 0.780 for Vanilla KV Sharing while reducing ASR from 0.871 to 0.216.
reuse_metric.zh: ASR 約降低 65–75%，同時保留大部分任務效能；在 Qwen3-4B sequential PrivacyLens 設定中，Full-System LCGuard 的 helpfulness 為 0.710，相較 Vanilla KV Sharing 的 0.780，且 ASR 由 0.871 降至 0.216。
